title: account — fiscal position Thai edge cases (GAP-043)

key_findings.map_tax_algorithm: Three-branch logic: (1) empty fiscal position → passthrough; (2) fiscal position with no tax_ids → filter to taxes with no fiscal_position_ids; (3) fiscal position with tax_ids → use tax_map dict keyed src→[dest], fallback to original tax id
key_findings.tax_map_build: Computed field: iterates dest taxes, for each dest tax iterates dest.original_tax_ids to build src_id→[dest_id] reverse index
key_findings.auto_detection_priority: Three tiers: receipt override (company field) > manual partner assignment (property_account_position_id) > auto-detect by geo/VAT
key_findings.auto_detection_validators: Five validators: VAT required, zip range, state membership, country match, country group membership
key_findings.l10n_th_fiscal_positions: NONE — Thai template ships zero fiscal position records; all tax rows have empty fiscal_position_ids column
key_findings.l10n_th_wht: 4 WHT rates at 1/2/3/5% for both company (PND53) and personal (PND3) payers, with separate receivable accounts; WHT taxes not linked to any fiscal position
key_findings.intra_company_fpos: No Thai intra-company fiscal position defined; EU-specific VAT prefix matching logic exists but has no Thai equivalent
key_findings.critical_edge_case: Empty tax_ids on a fiscal position (NR-05) strips all taxes with any fiscal_position_ids assigned — potential trap for Thai export position configuration

thai_deployment_gaps.gap: No export (0% VAT) fiscal position template
thai_deployment_gaps.risk: Must configure 7%→0% tax substitution mapping manually; omitting this leaves export invoices at 7%

thai_deployment_gaps.gap: No fiscal position for VAT-exempt transactions
WHT + VAT fiscal position interaction undefined
thai_deployment_gaps.risk: If an export fiscal position strips VAT but partner also has WHT, the WHT behavior under fiscal position must be tested at runtime
Multi-entity Thai deployments must design and test intra-company position from scratch

thai_deployment_gaps.gap: Empty-mapping filter behavior on draft fiscal position
thai_deployment_gaps.risk: A fiscal position with no rules silently removes all non-domestic taxes; administrators may create empty positions expecting no effect
